translated_title: Mexico Has No Information or Evidence on Alleged Ties of Raúl Castro's Grandson to Human Trafficking in Quintana Roo
original_title: México no tiene información ni pruebas sobre presuntos nexos de nieto de Raúl Castro con trata de personas en QRoo
author: Gustavo Castillo García
meta_description: Responding to a New York Times report on a 'Cuban Mafia of Quintana Roo,' the Security Cabinet said it has no data linking crime to foreign officials or their relatives.
